name: filter-odata
title: Filter OData
description: Writes a filter-schema AST as an OData `$filter` expression: the full grammar, strings in single quotes with `''` escapes, dates unquoted, `in` for OData 4.01 or `or`ed `eq`s for 4.0.
docs: `odata(toFilterAst(schema, values), { inOperator })` returns the `$filter` value: `status in ('open','closed') and amount ge 100 and contains(title,'bug')`. `inOperator: false` writes `or`ed `eq`s for OData 4.0 servers; navigation paths use `/`. It takes `fields` and `dates` like every serializer and throws a `FilterSerializeError` for what it can't write safely. Pass it as `params: (filter) => ({ $filter: odata(toFilterAst(schema, filter)) })`.
